670:t_1:88.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「I think this space is $$ミカゲ$$'s closed-off heart itself.」

670:t_1:89.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「So whether it's song or drill, breaking through the wall of dimensions is...」

670:t_1:90.en:
$$シリウス$$
「Are you saying it's impossible?」

670:t_1:93.en:
$$カグラ$$
「If this is $$ミカゲ$$'s heart, then all we have to do is take down that bastard $$ミカゲ$$, right?」

670:t_1:94.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Then we're fine. Knowing that bastard, he'll come to finish us off with his own hands in the end.」

670:t_1:95.en:
$$アポロ$$
「If we win when he does, we can get out of this space. I'm sure of it.」

670:t_1:97.en:
$$シュレード$$
「We can't expect too much. A curse keeps going even after the one who cast it is destroyed.」

670:t_1:98.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「You mean even beating him won't be enough?」

670:t_1:99.en:
$$シュレード$$
「I'm talking about a possibility. At this point, I can't say anything.」

670:t_1:100.en:
$$カイエン$$
「But right now, all we can do is bet on it.」

670:t_1:101.en:
$$ジン$$
「There's still a worrying factor. Whether the cunning $$ミカゲ$$ would risk showing himself in front of us...」

670:t_1:102.en:
$$ジン$$
「If he does make a move, it will be when he's absolutely confident.」

670:t_1:104.en:
$$ジン$$
「...We may have to steel ourselves...」

670:t_1:105.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「No way...! After coming this far!」

670:t_1:106.en:
$$アンディ$$
「That's right! I won't have it! I'm not going out like this, dying like a dog in a place like this!」

670:t_1:107.en:
$$モロイ$$
「If only Supreme Commander $$不動$$ were here at a time like this...」

670:t_1:108.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「With that man's mysterious power, he'd probably get us out of here.」

670:t_1:110.en:
$$アマタ$$
「...Let's throw away our weak feelings.」

670:t_1:112.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Supreme Commander $$不動$$ isn't here. If we keep trying to rely on someone who isn't here, we'll never win.」

670:t_1:113.en:
$$アポロ$$
「We don't need that old man's power. Let's turn this around with just our own strength.」

670:t_1:115.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I don't know what to do either... But I think that instead of relying on someone else, we have to find a way with our own strength.」

670:t_1:117.en:
$$モロイ$$
「That won't do. I seem to have gotten faint-hearted.」

670:t_1:118.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「Yeah! It's at times like this that we have to look ahead!」

670:t_1:119.en:
$$カイエン$$
「You've learned to speak up, $$アマタ$$.」

670:t_1:120.en:
$$アマタ$$
「If we keep leaning on others forever, we couldn't beat those $$御使い$$s either.」

670:t_1:121.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Yeah! We can't let guys who think humans are their pets keep throwing their weight around.」

670:t_1:122.en:
$$カグラ$$
「I'll blast $$ミカゲ$$, blast $$バアル$$, and blast those guys too!」

670:t_1:123.en:
$$クレア$$
「It looks like they'll be all right...」

670:t_1:124.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Don't worry, Chairwoman $$クレア$$. The $$エレメント$$s are growing too.」

670:t_1:125.en:
$$アムロ$$
「As both Supreme Commanders $$不動$$ wished, they should keep moving forward on their own strength.」

670:t_1:126.en:
$$クレア$$
「...Captain $$アムロ$$, you knew about $$不動ＧＥＮ#pilot$$ too, didn't you.」

670:t_1:127.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$不動ＧＥＮ#pilot$$ and $$不動ＺＥＮ$$... I don't intend to ask about their relationship.」

670:t_1:128.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But I think the two of them trained the $$エレメント$$s and us for the same purpose.」

670:t_1:129.en:
$$クレア$$
「So you do understand, after all.」

670:t_1:130.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...Thinking about it now, that man knew everything all along and chose not to intervene.」

670:t_1:132.en:
$$クレア$$
「Yes... And the $$エレメント$$s are surely advancing along the path $$不動$$ showed, faster than $$不動$$ ever imagined.」

670:t_1:133.en:
$$アムロ$$
「And I believe that's true not only of them but of us... no, of all humanity.」

670:t_1:134.en:
$$アムロ$$
(But I'm reaching the point where my willpower won't last...)

670:t_1:135.en:
$$アムロ$$
(When someone's mental fatigue passes the limit, that's where the cracks begin... That man will never miss it...)

670:t_1:139.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Deck ～

670:t_1:141.en:
$$ランカ$$
「...I'm sorry, $$アルト$$... You're busy too, and I'm making you put up with my selfishness...」

670:t_1:142.en:
$$アルト$$
「Don't worry about it. In a situation like this, anyone would be anxious.」

670:t_1:143.en:
$$アルト$$
「Besides, the Major asked me to look after you, too.」

670:t_1:144.en:
$$ランカ$$
「You're keeping me company because Big Bro told you to...?」

670:t_1:146.en:
$$ランカ$$
「...You're kind, $$アルト$$... But sometimes... that hurts...」

670:t_1:148.en:
$$ランカ$$
「I'm sorry... But I... I think I'm at my limit...」

670:t_1:149.en:
$$ランカ$$
「I know it's unfair to do this where $$シェリル$$ can't see... But if I'm going to die here anyway...」

670:t_1:150.en:
$$アルト$$
「Stop it, $$ランカ$$. Don't give up hope.」

670:t_1:151.en:
$$ランカ$$
「I... I love you, $$アルト$$!」

670:t_1:155.en:
$$アルト$$
「Turn down $$ランカ$$'s feelings」
「Accept $$ランカ$$'s feelings」

670:t_1:159.en:
$$ランカ$$
「It's funny, isn't it... Hearing how you feel, $$アルト$$, is so much scarier... than singing in the middle of a battle...」

670:t_1:163.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The seeds of hatred and jealousy finally bear fruit. I've come to fetch you, girl with the spring-green hair.」

670:t_1:164.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ミカゲ$$! When did you get onto the $$クォーター$$!」

670:t_1:166.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Now, come with me. Along with your unrequited feelings.」

670:t_1:168.en:
$$アルト$$
「Thank you, $$ランカ$$. I'm happy to hear how you feel.」
